AxSecurityPrivilege.Name: HSMobileOpsLicenseImport
AxSecurityPrivilege.Label: Import mobile app license
AxSecurityPrivilege.HelpText: Paste in the certificate and license the vendor issued, and see the current license status and device usage. HSMobileOpsLicenseSetup's own insert()/update() verify the pair before saving - this privilege only gates who can reach the form at all.
